title: Benchmarking LLM abilities on postdoc-level natural science problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.24321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific problems have no answer key, so evaluating an agent means deciding what counts as a better solution before any agent is run. Existing benchmarks either match a symbolic answer against a key or, where they require executable work, score it by unit tests, by a rubric, or by position on a competition leaderboard. None of these is the criterion by which a field decides that one published method beats another. STEMBench adopts that criterion directly. Each of its twelve research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics and neuroscience is scored by its own field's figure of merit, and each comes with two measured anchors: a submission that uses no domain knowledge, and an expert reference reproducing a published method, both obtained by running code shipped with the benchmark. translated_title: 基准测试大语言模型在博士后级别自然科学问题上的能力
translated_abstract: 科学问题没有标准答案，因此评估一个智能体意味着在任何智能体运行之前，就必须先确定什么才算更好的解决方案。现有的基准测试要么将符号答案与标准答案进行匹配，要么在需要可执行工作的场景下，通过单元测试、评分标准或竞赛排行榜上的名次来打分。这些都不是一个学科领域判定某个已发表方法优于另一种方法时所采用的标准。STEMBench 直接采用了这一标准。它包含十二个分别属于高能物理、天体物理学和神经科学的研究问题，每个问题都用其所属领域的核心评价指标来评分，并且每个问题都附带两个实测锚点：一个是不使用任何领域知识的提交方案，另一个是复现已发表方法的专家参考方案，两者均通过运行基准测试随附的代码获得。这两个锚点之间的差距表明了一个问题中有多少部分需要依靠科学洞察而非工程实现来跨越。在八个前沿模型上，任务……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 STEMBench，一个以后博士级别自然科学研究问题为对象的新基准，直接采用各学科自身判定方法优劣的核心评价指标（而非答案匹配或单元测试）来评估大语言模型智能体，并通过“无领域知识基线”与“专家参考方案”两个实测锚点之间的差距，量化区分科学洞察与工程实现各自的贡献。
en_tdlr: STEMBench is a benchmark of twelve postdoc-level research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics, and neuroscience that scores LLM agents by each field's own figure of merit, using two measured anchors—a no-domain-knowledge baseline and an expert reference reproducing a published method—to quantify how much of each problem is crossed by scientific insight rather than engineering.
